name: Transcend Coffee
description: Edmonton coffee roaster selling roasted and green coffee beans, espresso blends, instant coffee, subscriptions and brewing accessories online on Shopify. States free shipping over 65 dollars in Alberta and over 75 dollars across Canada, and also quotes shipping to the United States and Europe.
description_es: Tostador de café de Edmonton que vende en línea granos tostados y verdes, mezclas para espresso, café instantáneo, suscripciones y accesorios. Indica envío gratis en Alberta y en todo Canadá sobre un monto mínimo, y cotiza envíos a Estados Unidos y Europa.

ships_to.notes: Ships across Canada via Canada Post Expedited; free shipping over 75 dollars Canada-wide and over 65 dollars in Alberta; 10 dollar minimum order. Also quotes US and Europe rates.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Local pickup from Ritchie Market in Edmonton, ready within 3 business days.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Coffee is roasted to order and ships within two to three business days.

sources.supports: Canada-wide shipping thresholds, Canada Post shipping, Ritchie Market pickup, US and Europe shipping
